name: @turbomusic/electron
description: TurboMusic desktop app: the web client plus its own server, with the library on disk
author: TurboMusic

scripts.dist:publish: pnpm --filter @turbomusic/web build && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --publish always
scripts.dist:server: pnpm --filter @turbomusic/web build && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.server.json --win
scripts.dist:server:publish: pnpm --filter @turbomusic/web build && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.server.json --win --publish always
scripts.dist:app: pnpm --filter @turbomusic/web build && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.app.json
scripts.dist:app:publish: pnpm --filter @turbomusic/web build && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.app.json --publish always
scripts.dist:server:linux: pnpm --filter @turbomusic/web build && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.server-linux.json --linux
scripts.dist:server:linux:publish: pnpm --filter @turbomusic/web build && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.server-linux.json --linux --publish always
